summary: The session focused on Master Data Management (MDM) strategies, highlighting best practices and common pitfalls organizations face when implementing MDM. It emphasized the importance of aligning business outcomes with data governance and management efforts, advocating for a collaborative approach among stakeholders. The speaker provided frameworks and actionable insights to help organizations effectively build their MDM programs and maintain stakeholder engagement.

key_points: MDM is gaining attention due to AI's influence on data governance.
Understanding stakeholder needs is crucial for MDM success.
Business cases often fail due to lack of alignment with organizational goals.
Focus on cost optimization and measurable outcomes to gain support.
Avoid taking on too much too soon in MDM initiatives.
Engage stakeholders early and emphasize the team aspect of governance.

key_takeaways: Align MDM initiatives with business outcomes to secure stakeholder buy-in.
Adopt a phased approach to MDM, focusing on incremental value delivery.
Engage stakeholders continuously to ensure ongoing support and governance.
